On Wed, May 12, 2021 at 12:02 PM Mike Bradow < [opaque block] [contact omitted]> wrote:
Hi Nicole,
Thanks for following up on this. Totally understandable that you all want to keep the session internal. Perhaps you
could use that as an opportunity to crowdsource any questions/issues that the group would like to explore with FB
in a future conversation? We're open to doing something in June/July, whenever is timely for you all.
Mike
From: Nicole Goodrich <[contact omitted]>
Sent: Wednesday, May 5, 2021 10:27 AM
To: Mike Bradow < [opaque block] [contact omitted]>
Cc: Joshua Machleder <[contact omitted]>
Subject: Re: Panel Discussion
Ні Mike,
Hope your morning is going well.
Thanks for your willingness to speak during the disinformation session at the Asia Pacific DRG conference. The
organizing team decided to keep the session focused on internal USAID work like Josh's disinfo primer and disinfo
projects in the Philippines and Indonesia.
I do not think you are crushed with this news, but it would be great to see you on a computer screen again. So, a
question. Would you be interested in speaking separately to colleagues across Asia and the Pacific (and Asia
Bureau Washington) about Facebook and disinfo? We could plan a meeting for early June if that would work for you
(and you couldinclude your colleague in Singapore). Really anytime this summer would be great - June or July.
If you are interested, let me know your availability.
Thanks again, Mike.
Sincerely,
Nicole
Sincerely,
Nicole
